about: Pain red-flag model: logistic regression on character n-grams. Trained on titles of published Arabic consultations (Shifaa, Kaggle, Apache 2.0, even consultation numbers) and synthetic notes (ml/pain/training-notes.jsonl); not reviewed by a clinician. Used only together with the word list (flag if either flags).
